# Store Named Attribute

Stores values on the current geometry elements.

`lfs.store_named_attribute` · Attribute

## How to use

Use the same name in a later Named Attribute node. Unselected elements retain an existing value or use zero.\
Splat and point attributes persist through later modifiers; mesh vertex attributes are dropped on Apply.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry receiving the attribute. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Per-element write weight from 0 to 1. |
| Name | `Name` | lfs.string | attribute | — | Attribute name used by later Named Attribute nodes. |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.any | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Float, vector or colour field to store. |
